title: AuthorityV1
description: Cross-repository contract for authority classification. See authority-v1.md for prose definition.

authority_scope.description: Specific scope within the authority class (e.g., 'attention_guidance' for decision_support)

can_establish_truth.description: Whether this authority class can establish acoustic or objective truth (always false)

can_authorize_execution.description: Whether this authority class can authorize machine execution (always false)

can_enter_measurement_export.description: Whether artifacts with this authority may enter measurement export packages

source_repo.description: Repository that produced this authority declaration

local_authority_type.description: Repository-local authority type name for mapping (e.g., 'AuthorityClass.DECISION_SUPPORT')
